checks.name: initial
checks.coverage: All 16 binary K-map entries repeated three times; 48 selected-output checks plus full-vector checks

limitations: Development verification is not official evaluation; no official feedback was accessed.
Original specification does not define X/Z input behavior; verification covers all binary input combinations.
Contract gate validates structure only, not functional correctness.
implementation_rationale: Original K-map columns implement c OR d, zero, c OR NOT d, and c AND d at indices 0,1,2,3. Three conditional expressions implement the three nonconstant functions as 2-to-1 multiplexers, using constants and wires without additional logic gates.
